scripts.design:lint: npx -y @google/design.md@0.4.0 lint ../DESIGN.md | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',(d)=>(s+=d)).on('end',()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);for(const f of r.findings)if(f.severity!=='info')console.log(f.severity+': '+f.message);console.log('errors: '+r.summary.errors+', warnings: '+r.summary.warnings);process.exit(r.summary.errors+r.summary.warnings>0?1:0)})"
scripts.design:check: npm run design:lint && npx -y @google/design.md@0.4.0 export --format css-tailwind ../DESIGN.md | sed -E 's/^(  --font-[a-z-]+): "(.*)";$/\1: \2;/' | diff - src/design-tokens.css
scripts.e2e:stack: docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v && docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build --wait
